meta.name: ecommerce-full-pipeline
meta.description: 电商运营在开展跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏业务时，若需解决选品难、上架繁琐等痛点，必用此技能！一键打通“爆品挖掘→1688采集→多平台上架→推广文案→短视频生成”全自动流水线，轻松实现端到端自动化，让开店运营效率翻倍。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成从爆品挖掘到上架推广的电商全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏，想省掉选品上架的繁琐
copy.tagline_en: Automate the full ecommerce flow from product discovery to listing and promotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do cross-border or Xianyu sales and want to skip manual listing.

howto.what: Claude 会调用一套命令行工具：从 1688 采集商品、清洗数据（翻译标题、算利润率）、生成上架模板与推广文案、制作竖屏短视频，还能挖掘爆品趋势、搜闲鱼捡漏和代发下单。
howto.when: 当你需要开展跨境电商业务，或做闲鱼二手选品捡漏时触发，例如选品、上架、推广等环节。

say.text: 帮我用「收纳盒、蓝牙耳机」做种子词，跑一遍全自动流水线
say.note: 依次完成挖掘、采集、上架、推广、视频

say.text: 搜闲鱼 999 元以内的投影仪，要求 4K、云台，9 成新
say.note: 按捡漏评分排序输出结果

say.text: 给清洗后的商品生成 15 秒竖屏推广视频
say.note: 输出 9:16 竖屏视频，带 Ken Burns 特效

howto.what_en: Claude drives a CLI toolset: scrape 1688 products, clean data (title translation, profit margin), generate listing templates, ad copy and vertical promo videos, and dig trends or Xianyu bargains.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you take on cross-border e-commerce or Xianyu second-hand sourcing, e.g. product selection, listing or promotion.

say_en.text: Run the full auto-pipeline with storage box and Bluetooth earphones as seed keywords
say_en.note: Runs discovery, scraping, listing, promo and video

say_en.text: Search Xianyu for projectors under 999 yuan, requiring 4K and a gimbal
Generate 15-second vertical promo videos for the cleaned products
say_en.note: Outputs 9:16 videos with Ken Burns effect
